headline: mm2 Asia Restructuring Scheme Approved by Creditors
summary: Former Cathay Cineplex operator mm2 Asia received creditor approval for its restructuring scheme, which includes a share placement to raise $15 million with $11.5 million allocated for creditors.
why: Debt restructurings and equity placements are critical mechanisms for financially distressed entertainment and operating companies to avoid insolvency.

impacts.name: mm2 Asia Ltd.
impacts.why: Creditor approval of restructuring and share placements directly impacts the company's debt obligations and equity structure.
